intent_anchor.user_goal: Deliver a safe provider-neutral Paid AGM gateway using the established Grok subagent workflow.
intent_anchor.current_priority: Accept G5 only after product authority fixes and complete MAF evidence.

claim_under_review: G5-001 and its corrections meet the Paid gateway boundary acceptance criteria.
what_i_accept: All 36 gateway tests pass, including independent adversarial replays for hard caps, non-finite values, provider authority and idempotency conflicts.
Godot paid adapter passes 14 checks; edition parity, clean integrated boot and project validator pass.
Secret and network-import scans over product files are clean.
Real provider selection, credentials and outbound networking remain disabled and HITL_REQUIRED.
All six correction receipts validate against the canonical MAF agent_step_contract schema.
Correction 002 changed only C4_persist.json and grok_status.json.
what_i_challenge: Idempotency remains in-memory and real provider transport remains unimplemented; neither is claimed as production readiness.
strongest_counter_argument: The Godot adapter is still a fixture mirror rather than a live Paid API path, but G5 explicitly prohibits real provider/network enablement without HITL and therefore establishes the safe boundary rather than production connectivity.
missing_evidence: Production provider credentials, transport and operational monitoring remain future HITL work.
The adversarial-review skill references absent schema files, so this review follows its documented fields but could not be validated against that skill schema.
blind_spots: No claim of public endpoint, production SLA or live provider support is made.
next_action: Proceed to a local two-client authoritative POC without selecting a production multiplayer backend.
